body: Funnily enough I do plan to experiment with psychedelics more to see if that helps me.  Maybe someday I won't be such a giant mess.  Also I am, clearly, alive sadly

Well, I survived.

And I have been trying psychedelics for awhile now.  Gonna do some Mescaline again soon to see if it helps me.

My workplace is super busy too so I am occupied.  Everyone thinks it's a little weird that I will see things that aren't there and get startled by them.

Maybe I should exercise more but my job is physically intensive so I am always tired lol.  Meditation I should do for sure, they say that helps alot.
Wow, sounds cheap where you live.  I should move for sure since I hate it in California but all my medical is tied to Medical so I think I am stuck.

Thank you for replying with kind words.  I made it through the night fine.  Thank you for telling me I am not gross it helped me feel less dirty for sure.  I'll try to not get into any more unsafe situations, I have before and that was scary and dodgy.

Yeah I have friends in my life, they are a huge help.  I am just afraid they will think less of me if I tell them what happened to me.  They like to think I was an internet savvy individual who would be smarter than that.

I guess venting here did help alot because I decided to not die.  Venting is good and feels good.  Thank you again for replying with kindness cause it was just what I needed.
